description: Play music, radio or streams on the home speakers, speak text or announcements aloud (text-to-speech, including a spoken summary of fetched news), group speakers for synchronized playback, and control playback and volume. Acts on the home, then reports exactly what it did.
examples: Play some jazz in the kitchen
Play NPR on the living room speaker
Turn the volume down in the bedroom
Stream the BBC World Service on all speakers
Play my morning playlist on the Sonos
Say dinner is ready on the downstairs speakers
Announce that the kids need to come to the car
What's playing in the living room?
negatives: Find the email about the concert tickets
continuations: send it to the bedroom speaker

profile.style: After acting, say exactly what you did and where, using the 'did' line in each tool result. If a speaker was skipped, unavailable or not in sync, say so. Never claim an action you did not run. If a tool result says DRY RUN, tell the user it was only a rehearsal and nothing actually happened.
